text.title: Bumblebee
text.menu_sub: Tiny! Buzz from flower to flower drinking nectar.
text.intro: You're a bumblebee! Fly from flower to flower and drink nectar.
text.hungry: You're hungry. Fly right up to a flower and drink its nectar.
text.no_food: No flower here. Fly right up to a blossom, then tap Drink.
text.dig: Digging... (a queen sleeps through winter in a little hole in the soil)
text.about_looks: Round and furry: black, with two yellow bands and a white tail. A queen is about 2 cm long.
text.about_food: Nectar and pollen from flowers. In spring, willow catkins; in autumn, heather.
text.about_home: In spring a queen starts a nest in an old vole hole or a tuft of moss.
text.about_winter: Only the young queens survive the winter, asleep in a small hole in the soil until spring.
text.about_young: The queen lays eggs and raises workers from May. New queens hatch in late summer.
text.about_fact: Bumblebees warm up by shivering their flight muscles, so they can fly on cold mornings.

year.shelter: In spring the queen starts a nest in an old vole hole or a tussock of moss. In autumn each new queen digs a small chamber in soil to sleep in.
year.young: The queen raises workers from May; new queens and males hatch in late summer.

food.summer: Nectar and pollen from many flowers.
food.winter: Asleep: only the new queens survive, living on stored fat.

year.notes: The old queen, the workers and the males all die in autumn. In winter, the game should show the queen asleep underground.
